## Summary

Implements the ADR 0124 production navigation foundation: engine-owned tiled polygon assets, stable agent profiles, neutral bake input/backend boundary, multi-height polygon queries, portals, off-mesh links, modifiers/area costs, typed path results, funnel-style smoothing, persistence, and compatibility through the existing NavMesh surface/agent runtime facade.

This Draft PR remains the task branch for the remaining ADR 0124 authoring and Editor workflow slices.
